mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the last month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP by more than 1% in the last quarter signals a decline in economic demand, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies report lower earnings and investors anticipate a recession.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between GDPC1 decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% in the last two months signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over the last two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector is a key economic indicator.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the proxy shows a sustained increase, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it indicates inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in the last month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor confidence in the economy grows.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of increasing PAYEMS and decreasing UNRATE on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real retail and food services sales by more than 2% in the last month signals a weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between RSAFS decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
